title: RNA Extraction and Library Preparation for Mouse Proximal Large Intestine Sequencing
author: Anastasiya Moiseyenko
materials: ABclonal FAST RNA-seq Library Prep Kit
Assess RNA integrity using an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Collect and Preserve Tissue
steps.instruction: Harvest proximal large intestine tissue and stabilize for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Dissect approximately 1 cm of proximal large intestine from each mouse.
Immediately place tissue into TRIzol reagent (Zymo Research) and flash-freeze on dry ice.
Store samples at –80 °C until RNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract and Purify Total RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate total RNA and remove genomic DNA contamination.

substeps.instruction: Extract total RNA using the Direct-zol RNA MiniPrep Plus Kit (Zymo Research) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Perform on-column DNase I treatment as specified by the kit to remove genomic DNA.
Measure RNA concentration and purity using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Prepare RNA-seq Libraries
steps.instruction: Generate sequencing libraries using the ABclonal FAST RNA-seq Library Prep Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Perform Sequencing
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq X platform.

substeps.instruction: Target a sequencing depth of ~30 million reads per sample.

steps.title: Align Reads and Quantify Counts
steps.instruction: Process raw sequencing data to obtain gene-level counts.

substeps.instruction: Align raw sequencing reads to the Mus musculus GRCm36 Primary Assembly reference genome (GENCODE Release M36) using STAR aligner v2.7.1 with default parameters.
Quantify gene-level read counts using featureCounts.
Retain only protein-coding genes with a minimum total count ≥ 10 across all samples.

steps.title: Perform Differential Expression Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze count data in R (v4.3.0) to identify differentially expressed genes.

substeps.instruction: Normalize counts and perform differential expression analysis using the DESeq2 package.
Identify differentially expressed genes using an adjusted p-value < 0.05 and a Log2 fold change threshold as defined per comparison.

steps.title: Conduct Functional Enrichment Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform gene ontology and pathway enrichment analyses using the clusterProfiler package.

substeps.instruction: Apply an adjusted p-value criterion of 0.2.
